media.title: Gifstadian Parlimentary vote to invade Stockstrand
media.description: This screenshot shows Nick [Current Prime minister] initiating a bill in the Gifstadian Parliment to join Fishermann's [Leader of Severmark and ally in NVC] effort of invading Stockstrand. The screenshot was produced after the events to prove Gifstad's voluntary involvment in a conversation with Sebisuper9mil.

media.title: "Was Gifstad peak?" - End of SL2 polling
media.description: This screenshot shows Sebisuper9mil making a poll in Gifstadian ProposalVoting on if Gifstad was "the peakest nation ever". The poll had a turn out with considerable odds to Gifstad with only Bonana and Hero [both former Solarians] voting no. The poll also was the first poll when all Gifstadian chats went public for viewing. A notable aspect of the poll is how unorthodox it was to ping everyone for a poll on if Gifstad was the most peak nation but it serves as a testiment to public opinion on Gifstad when SL2 ended.

media.title: Decree of a Gifstadian Airforce
media.description: This screenshot shows the user retutzi proposing a bill to officialize the Gifstadian Air force as a legal entity to protect Gifstad and it's allies. The decree comes from massive sucess previously from the famous Blimps that are often called "Gifstadian skydevils" and early reconnaissance planes that surveiled that also served a role in not just "reconnaissance" but also in creating early attack planes that might of not served in the Gifstadian Air force due to the second meteor but it did significantly shine a step into an era of Gifstadian domination in the sky. This bill passed 9-0-0 [Yes - No - Abstain].

media.title: Negociation over Anglion Territory [rainbow / lementation]
media.description: This screenshot shows rainbow's perspective of communicating with Lemenation [currently queen of Anglion] over territory near the Gifsk isles he asks for due to cultural and strategic positioning. The plan did not go over due to "A war with Suralia" and the importance of it and nearby territories [such as the "islands near the sealists"]. The file continues with Lementation being offered to sell a part of Vinna to rainbow for a hefty amount. The deal was closed with VT leadership declining the sale of the strip of land.
